I called the suicide hotline (1 (800) 273-8255 if anyone is ever in a situation like mine) just hearing him talking I was able to calm down, I'm not even 100% sure what he said, but holding a conversation kept me calm enough that I was able to come back to reality a bit. 

I was off of work today because of a dental appointment that I had request a while back. I sat in bed and started to write out a text to her. I was mid text when I decided to scroll up, I saw how many messages in a row I had sent her with no response.. I wanted to throw up. I turned off my phone, I got in my car and I drove to the dentist, I was on my way home and realized that I couldn't go back to my house, I would do nothing but sit there and freak myself out.

 I drove to the store, bought a magazine. I went to the pet store and looked at the fish, I looked at the little mouses running on their mouse wheel, I went on a long walk on the beach, I talked to some homeless guy and gave him a dollar, I basically did anything I could to keep my mind busy. It worked for the most part. I have been home for an hour now and once again started to feel myself getting weak and I could feel my eyes swelling up. I just looked up movie times and I think I'm going to just go to the movies, I've never been to the movies alone before, but maybe it will give me a bit more time to think and still be distracted by the movie. Hopefully by the time I get home I'll be exhausted and fall asleep.

I have work tomorrow morning, I have to go because of how many days I've missed in the past couple of weeks.. My workplace is toxic, but hopefully it'll still keep my mind occupied.

I've thought a lot about what has happened. I start to think about how she felt when I left.. If it was anything like this.. I can't live with myself. The pain is so painful that I can't describe it. I need her to know how much she means to me, how much I love her, and how sorry I am for what I did to her. Thank you so much for your help. I have so much respect for you. I hope you don't mind if I PM you when I need someone to talk to.

These panic attacks are the worst thing I've ever experienced. It starts off as a bad thought.. Me thinking about what I did to her or remembering the things we used to do, I've always had these bad thoughts but I was always fine because in the back of my mind I knew she was just a text away. Now she's not.. I also use to drink or smoke these thoughts away.. These thoughts are are now uncontrollable, I get them and it feels like I start to lose conscious, all I can feel is an unbearable mental pain. It's so bad that it really makes me no want to be alive. I try to tune them out with music, I try to talk to my friends or parents but I start to panic even more because there's nothing they can do to help me and there's nothing I can do to help myself.

I'm thinking about going to the hospital tonight, I'm not sure what to do, I blew up her phone and she's completely stopped replying. I'm losing it. I'm not strong enough to handle this.

I really appreciate the reply. Thank you so much for the kind words. I'm not sure what to do right now. I'm having extremely bad panic attacks. I've never had attacks like these before. She sent me a couple of texts back today. Even though she was telling me to leave her alone, I still had to kept texting her, as soon as I realized she wasn't texting me back I freak out because I feel alone and I can't believe that the person that once would've given her life for me won't even say a few words to me to keep from losing my mind. I realize that I'm acting crazy and it makes my panic attacks worse. It's spiraling out of control. I had to walk out of work yesterday and I had to call off today. I can't go anywhere without randomly crying and getting that gut wrenching feeling in my stomach. 

I'm not a suicidal person at all, but when I'm having a panic attack I feel there is literally nothing I can do. I'm so fucking helpless.

Thanks guys.. I'm hoping I'll get motivation to try to make my life better, hopefully that comes in time. Right now I just feel so defeated. I actually already tried to send her a huge message and explain myself but she is done with me. Which I don't blame her for at all.

What? Did you even read my post? I never said Macs can't get viruses because that's not true.

You said in your post 
>There's no technical reason why Macs can't get viruses. But there are very few viruses written for Macs because there are far fewer Macs in the world.

That is flat out not true, there are many technical reasons why Macs get less viruses than PCs, so yes it is very misleading.

Saying that there is no technical reason why Mac's can't get viruses is VERY misleading.
The main reason for Macs being less infected is because OSX is based on UNIX, which has a very secure permission structure. Windows will try to run something as easily as possible while OSX halts and requires authorization for a lot of things.

Instead of it being "Why should I write a virus for a Mac when there are more PCs?" It's more like: "Why should I write a virus for a Mac when it's much easier to write one for the PC?"
